plain_english_revision: The amendment modifies SB301 by removing or clarifying language related to sexting, non-consensual image distribution, and juvenile sentencing for child pornography offenses. It also adds specific intent requirements and references to statutory definitions.
candidate_position_supported: Advancing stricter enforcement of non-consensual image distribution crimes by requiring proof of harassing intent, while limiting juvenile registration requirements for child pornography offenses under specific conditions.
evidence_quotes: with the intent to harass, threaten, coerce, or intimidate the person depicted

The sentencing court may exempt from this chapter a juvenile sex offender adjudicated delinquent of a violation of the Alabama Child Pornography Act after the juvenile has been counseled on the dangers of the conduct for which he or she was adjudicated delinquent.
review_reason: The amendment text is clear and unambiguous, with no reliance on unseen language. The intent and effect are evident from the provided text.
